description: This PHP source file defines the OptionalFieldAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides REST API endpoints to retrieve and update configuration related to optional profile fields such as SSN, SIN, tax exemptions, and deprecated fields for the Employee Data Management (PIM) module.

classes.name: OptionalFieldAPI
